title.narrative: Transforming the Education System for Teachers and Students in Liberia (TESTS)

description.narrative: (Liberia): A major challenge facing the.Liberian education system is the training and employment of qualified teachers.at the early childhood and primary level. While the Ministry of Education (MOE).is undergoing a teacher vetting process to remove unqualified and non-performing.teachers from the payroll, USAID's Transforming the Education System for.Teachers and Students in Liberia (TESTS) improves teacher training at the.pre-service level to replace unqualified teachers with qualified ones. The.activity will support teachers with inclusive education pedagogy and practice.and provide education and equipment for students and instructors with.disabilities. This activity will also decrease the knowledge/skills gap that.prevents learners with disabilities from accessing quality education and will.provide disability-specific content in cases where support is required..Using FY 2022 funds, the TESTS.activity will help teachers adapt to a range of learning styles for children.and youth of varying abilities. USAID will engage higher education institutions.in the private sector (e.g., universities, community, faith-based colleges, and.education faculties) to provide pre-service education at the early childhood.education (ECE) and primary levels. The activity will assist private higher education.institutions to align with the MOE's ECE strategy and primary curriculum and.build the capacity of universities to support women's education and entry into.the teaching workforce. This activity supports the U.S. government's goal to.increase high-quality and equitable education and opportunities for children.and youth and contributes to the Administration's goal of growing economic.opportunities and prosperity for communities globally..
